instruction: Extract the project context, objective, actors, scope, constraints, assumptions, and missing information from the stakeholder input.
input: Project brief for ThresholdMoss Move-In Record: The objective is to document move-in property conditions, manage tenant disputes, and close the inspection after all entries are acknowledged or resolved. Property Inspectors create condition records, list inspected rooms, and record disputed entries as revised or unchanged. Inventory Clerks record listed fixtures and their condition. Incoming Tenants acknowledge entries or dispute them with comments. Property Officers return disputed entries to Property Inspectors. Lease Administrators close inspections after every entry is acknowledged or every dispute is resolved. Repair scheduling is outside the project. The fixture condition labels have not been defined.

output.business_objective: Document move-in property conditions, manage tenant disputes, and close the inspection after all entries are acknowledged or resolved.
